name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Pulling Back on Energy Efficiency
changes.summary: The Trump administration is undoing fuel-saving efforts even as war in Iran, data centers and heat waves are pushing up gasoline and electricity costs.

changes.title: Houthis in Yemen Edge Closer to Entering U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has declared a Red Sea blockade on Saudi Arabia, potentially opening a new front in the war rippling across the Middle East.

changes.title: Ex-U.S. attorney in Seattle sues Trump over firing
changes.summary: Roger Rogoff was fired from his role as U.S. attorney in Seattle shortly after judges on the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington appointed him to the job.

changes.title: Deadly attack on U.S. forces in Jordan part of evolving Iranian tactics
changes.summary: A retired Jordanian general tells CBS News Iran is "developing techniques and capacities" to target U.S. forces with increasing lethality.

changes.title: Iran retaliates after U.S. military carries out 10th night of strikes
changes.summary: The U.S. carried out its 10th consecutive night of strikes against Iran. Tehran said it retaliated by targeting U.S. assets in Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata reports.

changes.title: Friends remember 19-year-old U.S. soldier Isabella Gonzales after death in Iran strike
changes.summary: Isabella Gonzales' friends in Texas are fondly remembering the fallen soldier as they come to terms with her death on Friday in the U.S. war with Iran. CBS News Texas reports.

changes.title: Trump says U.S. would have to 'take care' of potential Houthi blockade of Red Sea
changes.summary: Asked about his level of concern about a blockade of the Red Sea by the Iranian-backed Houthi rebels, President Donald Trump suggested Tuesday it wasn't an immediate problem.

changes.title: U.S. soldier killed in Iraq was 30-year-old father from North Carolina
changes.summary: The U.S. military has identified a soldier killed while disarming an Iranian drone in Iraq as Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton from North Carolina.

changes.title: How Republicans Turned Olive Garden Into a Voter ID Talking Point
changes.summary: Republicans claim that Olive Garden polices its Never-Ending Pasta Bowl more tightly than the United States does its elections. It’s not that simple.
